description: This file defines a React context and provider for authentication management using Supabase. It includes hooks for accessing auth state, user profile, roles, and authentication actions such as sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, and token retrieval. The code manages session state, subscribes to auth changes, and fetches user profile data from an API endpoint.

methods.name: getMeUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for fetching user profile data from the backend API, adjusting based on whether the base URL ends with /api/v1.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component that provides authentication context, manages session, user, profile, role, and exposes authentication actions.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access the authentication context.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Alias hook for useSupabaseAuth, providing full auth context.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Hook to retrieve the current user's role ('member', 'trainer', 'admin') or null.
